subject: Catalyst — Expansion: New Projects + Key Batching Plan (Renewal Q3)
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maria Hsu <maria.hsu@catalyst.ai>, ops@averysolutions.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Catalyst — Expansion: New Projects + Key Batching Plan (Renewal Q3)

Hi Maria / Avery team,

Congrats again on finalizing the renewal — appreciate the quick turnaround. Per our conversation last week, Catalyst is looking to onboard three additional internal projects (analytics, customer-chat, and ingestion pipelines) over Q3. I wanted to put a concrete proposal on the table for how we provision additional API keys and stage the rollout so you get predictable throughput without spiking unit costs.

Proposal highlights (short):
- Issue three new constrained key namespaces (one per project) and group them into two batching windows to reduce per-token cold start cost.
- Staged enablement: pilot (week 1), ramp (weeks 2–4), full traffic (week 6).
- Temporary burst capacity for go-live days (pre-approved credit window).
- Minor term amendment to include these keys under the existing renewal (DocuSign link to follow).

I've attached a draft scope and a simple key-batching sheet to show how requests can be bucketed. Can you confirm:
1) Does Catalyst want strictly separated keys per project (preferred for governance) or shared keys with namespace tags?
2) Any blackout dates for Q3 we should avoid for the pilot?

Next steps I suggest: intro call Monday 6/10 to review the pilot runbook and sign the amendment so we can provision keys the week of 6/17.

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your security/ops constraints.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: catalyst_scope_v2.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]
[Attachment: key-batching-proposal.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

From: Maria Hsu <maria.hsu@catalyst.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@averysolutions.com
Date: Fri, 7 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Catalyst — Expansion: New Projects + Key Batching Plan (Renewal Q3)

Thanks Connor — this looks like the right direction. Quick answers inline: 

1) Separation: We prefer separated keys per project for auditability.
2) Blackout dates: 7/4–7/6 (holiday maintenance window) and 8/14–8/16 (internal release). Avoid those for major changes.

A few clarifying questions:
- On burst capacity: will that be billed against renewal credits or invoiced separately?
- Security/compliance: Avery (our SRE partner) will need a short questionnaire to map key rotation responsibilities.

We are available for a Monday call at 10am PT.

Regards,
Maria Hsu
Head of Platform, Catalyst.ai
Avery Solutions (SRE) is looped for ops specifics.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 7 Jun 2028 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Catalyst — Expansion: New Projects + Key Batching Plan (Renewal Q3)

Adding a technical approach for the call — keeping it short so we can align ops.

Key-batching proposal (summary):
- Create 3 key namespaces: catalyst-analytics, catalyst-chat, catalyst-ingest.
- Two runtime batching windows: steady-state (500ms aggregate latency target) and batch-collect (for low-priority ingestion jobs).
- KV-prefix caching on steady-state keys to reduce token re-computation for repeated prompts.
- Provision a 72-hour burst buffer for each namespace tied to the existing renewal credits. If burst usage exceeds the buffer, default to on-demand billing at negotiated rate.

Attachment: I uploaded a sample traffic schedule in key-batching-proposal.xlsx (workloads + expected TTK).

On the security questionnaire — we can prep an ops checklist for Avery to complete before provisioning.

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[Attachment reference: key-batching-proposal.xlsx]

Hi all — Avery SRE here. Quick note on compliance and rotation:

- We need clear rotation cadence included in the runbook (30/90 day options).
- For separated keys, give us a minimal API to rotate keys via the console (API token or admin flow).
- We prefer keys scoped to namespaces rather than shared tags.

We'll fill out the short questionnaire Ben mentioned. Can you send the checklist today so we can return it by Monday?

— Avery Ops
Avery Solutions (SRE Partner)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Catalyst — Expansion: New Projects + Key Batching Plan (Renewal Q3)

Thanks for the quick turnaround, everyone. Following our Monday call, we updated the amendment to fold the three new namespaces into your renewed contract. Highlights:

- Amendment: adds 3 named key namespaces and a shared 72-hour burst buffer (applies per namespace).
- Billing: burst usage draws from renewal credits first; excess billed monthly at the previously quoted overage rate.
- Term change: extend billing review period by 30 days to allow for measured ramp and ensure cost predictability.

I've uploaded the DocuSign amendment (signed-by-redwood stub) and the updated scope to Drive. Please review; I'll send the final DocuSign when Catalyst confirms.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-AMPLIFY-789
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2catalyst-rollout-plan
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/86021/DEAL-2028-078

If this looks good, Connor — recommend we provision test keys the week of 6/17 and schedule the pilot cutover for 6/24.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

2) Please add a short rollback plan in the pilot runbook (if model latency > 700ms for two consecutive hours, we revert to pre-expanded routing).

If you can add those two items to the runbook, I'll approve the DocuSign and we can provision the test namespaces on 6/17. Can the DocuSign be routed to me today?
